parametrized_description: A communication network has NumNodes nodes connected by directed links. Each link from node i to node j has capacity Capacity and transmission cost Cost. There are NumSourceDestPairs source-destination pairs given by SourceDestPairs, each needing to send SourceData bits of data. Data can be split across multiple paths. Determine the flow on each link for each source-destination pair to minimize total transmission cost while respecting link capacities and satisfying all demands.

NumNodes.description: Total number of nodes in the network

Capacity.description: Capacity of the communication link from node i to node j in bits per second

Cost.description: Cost of transmitting data along the link from node i to node j

SourceDestPairs.description: Source and destination node indices for each pair

SourceData.description: Amount of data each source needs to send in bits

Flow.description: Amount of data flow on link (i, j) for source-destination pair k

constraints.description: Total flow on each link across all pairs must not exceed the link capacity.

code.gurobipy: model.addConstrs((quicksum(Flow[k, i, j] for k in range(NumSourceDestPairs)) <= Capacity[i][j] for i in range(NumNodes) for j in range(NumNodes)), name="CapLimit")

constraints.description: Flow conservation at each node for each pair: inflow minus outflow equals demand (positive at destination, negative at source, zero elsewhere).
constraints.formulation: \sum_{j} Flow_{k,j,n} - \sum_{j} Flow_{k,n,j} = \begin{cases} -SourceData_k & \text{if } n = source_k \\ SourceData_k & \text{if } n = dest_k \\ 0 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases} \quad \forall k, n

code.gurobipy: model.addConstrs((Flow[k, i, j] >= 0 for k in range(NumSourceDestPairs) for i in range(NumNodes) for j in range(NumNodes)), name="FlowNonNeg")

objective.description: Minimize total transmission cost across all links and all source-destination pairs.

code.gurobipy: model.setObjective(quicksum(Cost[i][j] * Flow[k, i, j] for k in range(NumSourceDestPairs) for i in range(NumNodes) for j in range(NumNodes)), GRB.MINIMIZE)
